text:
jules (partnerships): BlueHarbor submitted a model bundle claiming 'open weights' + 'commercial redistribution allowed'. They attached a contributors CSV and a short license summary but no signed tags. We should triage redistribution scope and any hardware bundling ask.

maria (legal): High-level: need cryptographic proof of origin (sigstore/GPG), contributor CLAs or DCO, and a complete license matrix. "Commercial redistribution" is vaguedoes it mean hosting, downloads, or resale by partners? Get specifics.

owen (hw-partner): If they want edge device bundling, we need explicit binary redistribution rights and a security contact. We also require package signing to integrate onto our devices.

kevin (product): From product side: allow hosted API quickly but gate downloads and partner bundles. Canary the listing with telemetry and limited traffic. Ask for quantized builds and performance numbers.

sig-bot: PROVENANCE_SCAN: no verified signatures found. FLAG: provenance_missing (HIGH). Recommend blocking redistributable SKUs until sigs verified.

alia (marketplace): Marketplace options: hosted-only, partner-bundle (restricted), full-redistribute. Until legal confirms, mark as hosted-only + badge "redistribution under review". Also need exact attribution copy if CC-BY content present.

jules (partnerships): I'll request: signed release (sigstore/GPG), CLA/DCO proof, SBoM, dataset manifests, and explicit redistribution definition (hosting vs downloads vs partner resell). ETA 72h.

maria (legal): Also ask about export-control: provider org country and contributor locations. If contributors are in embargoed countries we need extra review. Draft redistribution clause snippet to propose: "Provider grants Redwood a non-exclusive license to host the Model and, upon Provider's prior written consent, to distribute model binaries to Redwood-authorized partners and resellers. Provider warrants it has the rights to grant such licenses and that the Model contains no materials imposing ShareAlike obligations that would require downstream relicensing."

owen (hw-partner): For hardware bundling checklist: binary redistribution rights, package signing, vulnerability contact, and reseller authorization list. We'll also need a short SOW for preloading devices.

kevin (product): Canary plan: start at 3% traffic, telemetry enabled, auto-revert on takedown claim. Example snippet: `canary(percent=3, telemetry=true, auto_revert_on=["takedown","legal_claim"])`

alia (marketplace): If they insist on immediate redistributable downloads but cannot provide sigs/CLAs within 72h, we should refuse downloads and permit hosted-only with limited promotion.

jules (partnerships): Action items recap: (1) Jules to request docs from BlueHarbor (sigs, CLAs, SBoM, redistribution definition) ETA 72h. (2) Maria to post attestation template + redistribution clause draft ETA 48h. (3) Owen to outline HW bundle requirements + sample SOW. (4) Kevin to prepare canary config and telemetry hooks. (5) Alia to prepare listing flags and marketing gating checklist. Scheduling 20-min sync with provider + legal for tomorrow 9:30 PT.

maria (legal): I'll add a short FAQ on CC-BY vs CC-BY-SA impacts to the partnerships board. If ShareAlike applies, redistribution downloads may be blocked.

sig-bot: REMINDER: attach signed release to the marketplace ticket to clear provenance check.

jules (partnerships): Thanks all 44d Please update this thread with links once you post templates/docs.
